:::{#hero-heading}
Hi!

I'm a research associate at the Department of Sociology, LMU Munich, where I'm preparing my doctoral project. My research interests lie in property and wealth inequality, which I study with quantitative and computational methods. My current focus is on intellectual property (IP) and the ownership of knowledge.
